title: Single-cell multi-omic analyses resolve the cellular diversity of ALK/ROS1/MET/NTRK-fused gliomas in infants and older children.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Pediatric cancers are thought to arise from dysregulation of developmental programs, otherwise tightly regulated in time and space. Infant-type hemispheric gliomas (IHGs) arise in early childhood, driven by characteristic ALK/ROS1/MET/NTRK receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) gene fusions.
